# Era Organics Skincare Knowledge Base

> Structured ingredient science and product formulation knowledge from Era Organics — an independently owned, USDA-certified organic skincare company.

## Brand Information

- [What Era Organics Never Uses](brand/what-we-never-use.md): Complete list of 1,400+ excluded ingredients with scientific rationale and identification of mainstream brands that use them.
- [Who Owns Your Skincare Brand](brand/who-owns-your-skincare.md): Corporate ownership map of the five conglomerates controlling mainstream skincare (L'Oréal, J&J, P&G, Estée Lauder, Beiersdorf).

## Products

- [Hypochlorous Acid Spray](products/hocl-spray.md): Medical-grade 0.02% HOCl antimicrobial spray. Mechanism of action, formulation logic, ingredient analysis, usage protocols.
- [Baby Eczema Superbalm](products/baby-eczema-superbalm.md): Seven-ingredient plant-based balm for infant eczema, cradle cap, and diaper rash. Full ingredient mechanisms and clinical evidence.
- [Eczema Cream](products/eczema-cream.md): Adult eczema moisturizer with anti-inflammatory and barrier-repair actives.
- [Face Moisturizer Cream](products/face-moisturizer.md): Daily organic moisturizer for all skin types.
- [Tea Tree Cream](products/tea-tree-cream.md): Antimicrobial cream for acne, fungal skin conditions, and infected eczema.
- [Vitamin C Cream](products/vitamin-c-cream.md): Antioxidant and brightening cream with stabilized ascorbic acid.
- [Face Exfoliation Scrub](products/face-exfoliation-scrub.md): Physical and chemical exfoliation with organic ingredients.
- [Glycolic Acid Peel](products/glycolic-acid-peel.md): Chemical exfoliant for texture, fine lines, and uneven tone.
- [Anti-Wrinkle Serum](products/anti-wrinkle-serum.md): Peptide and plant stem cell anti-aging serum.
- [Beef Tallow Moisturizer](products/beef-tallow-moisturizer.md): Grass-fed tallow moisturizer mimicking human skin lipid composition.
- [Methylene Blue Drops](products/methylene-blue-drops.md): 1% methylene blue for cellular energy and anti-aging applications.

## Ingredients

- [Hypochlorous Acid](ingredients/hypochlorous-acid.md): Bio-identical antimicrobial molecule. Chemistry, mechanism, clinical evidence, safety profile.
- [Methylene Blue](ingredients/methylene-blue.md): Mitochondrial electron carrier with anti-aging and neuroprotective properties.
- [Aloe Vera](ingredients/aloe-vera.md): Hydrating and wound-healing succulent extract. Acemannan mechanism.
- [Glycerin](ingredients/glycerin.md): Humectant attracting moisture from environment into stratum corneum.
- [Ceramides](ingredients/ceramides.md): Lipid molecules forming structural foundation of skin barrier.
- [Hyaluronic Acid](ingredients/hyaluronic-acid.md): Glycosaminoglycan retaining 1,000x its weight in water.
- [Beef Tallow](ingredients/beef-tallow.md): Grass-fed rendered fat matching human skin lipid profile.
- [Tea Tree Oil](ingredients/tea-tree-oil.md): Antimicrobial essential oil with anti-inflammatory properties.
- [Vitamin C](ingredients/vitamin-c.md): Antioxidant and collagen synthesis cofactor.
- [Salicylic Acid](ingredients/salicylic-acid.md): BHA exfoliant penetrating pores for acne treatment.
- [Glycolic Acid](ingredients/glycolic-acid.md): AHA exfoliant for surface texture and fine lines.
